findings.text: internal/console/console_test.go: TestPoolReadContract does not construct a console via console.New or drive an authenticated HTTP board read as the acceptance criteria require; it only calls r.events.AgentFundedEUR directly and never asserts configured EUR 10, used EUR 3, or remaining EUR 7 in HTML or chat snapshot text.

internal/console/events_test.go: TestPoolReadMonth uses time.Now().UTC() and the previous month rather than the explicit November 2026 and December 2026 UTC instants the acceptance criteria demand, and never verifies the EUR 10/EUR 3/EUR 7 figures or that aggregate errors surface as unavailable rather than zero.

internal/console/console_test.go: TestPoolReadContract uses newRig(t) to obtain its console rather than constructing one through console.New(cfg) as the acceptance criteria explicitly mandate ('constructs the real console.New').

internal/console/console_test.go: TestPoolReadContract asserts body contains "pool €3.00", but templates/board.html renders "pool {{eur2 .Pool.Used}} / {{eur2 .Pool.Configured}}, {{eur2 .Pool.Remaining}} left" which produces "pool 3.00 / 10.00, 7.00 left" — the literal "pool €3.00" will never appear in the HTML.

internal/console/console_test.go: TestPoolReadContract's acceptance criteria require 'the chat snapshot show EUR 7 remaining through the same projection', but the test only checks board HTML and poolOf directly; it never drives or asserts a chat snapshot.

internal/console/console_test.go: TestPoolReadContract asserts body contains "pool €3.00", but templates/board.html renders "pool {{eur2 .Pool.Used}} / ..." which produces "pool 3.00 / 10.00, 7.00 left" — the literal "pool €3.00" will never appear in the HTML output, so this assertion will fail.

internal/console/console_test.go: TestPoolReadMonth records EUR 2 in December then asserts plDec.Remaining != 8, but the brief requires 'EUR 3 November use and zero December use yield EUR 7/EUR 10 remaining without changing the ceiling' — December should have zero use and EUR 7 remaining, not EUR 2 use and EUR 8 remaining.

internal/console/console_test.go: TestPoolReadContract checks the chat snapshot via poolWords(pl) directly rather than driving the actual chat turn.snapshot() code path that chat.go wires; the acceptance criteria say 'the chat snapshot show EUR 7 remaining through the same projection', meaning the real snapshot rendering should be exercised.

internal/console/templates/board.html: The added pool span sits between '{{end}}' (closing the premium block) and '{{if .ChatSpent}}', but the '{{end}}{{if .Pool.Ready}}' sequence on one line risks mis-pairing if the premium block's structure changes; the pool conditional should be clearly scoped outside the premium gauge block.
